flows.title: Create and train an AI agent
steps: The steps below are on the Chatbase dashboard, which a signed-in person reaches at https://www.chatbase.co/dashboard.
Click the New AI Agent button.
Choose what the agent learns from: files, text snippets, a website, Q&A or Notion — uploading your documents suits manuals, FAQs and product information.
Click Create Agent to begin training. It usually takes two to five minutes, depending on how much data there is, and you can carry on while it finishes.

flows.title: Refine an agent's instructions
steps: With the agent trained, go to Build, then Instructions.
Edit the instructions that shape how the agent behaves.
Use the Compare button to test the change side by side against the current version before saving it.

flows.title: Preview an agent the way a visitor sees it
steps: Open the Playground. It loads the channel you last worked on from the Channels page.
To preview a different channel, click the channel name at the top of the page and pick one from the list, or choose View all channels.
Click Preview in the top-right. The agent opens in a new tab on an otherwise empty page, so you see it as a visitor would.
Use the toolbar at the top of that page to switch the background between light and dark, or upload an image — a screenshot of your own site, say — to sit behind the agent.
The preview URL can be shared with anyone in your workspace to collect feedback.
